name: Account for the coupled chemical system
description: Choose an explicit account of matter, electrons, cofactors and energy needed for a conversion. Reopen incomplete boundaries when an isolated reaction is implausible or replacement changes metabolic demand.
use_when: Output conflicts with a redox/stoichiometric account, or routes with the same product may require different support.
live_alternatives: A consumed partner or favorable coupled reaction is missing.
Partial uncoupling or another conversion alters the account.
Same output hides changed input/cofactor recycling demand.
Chemistry remains unsupported under stated assumptions.
decision_guidance: Choose the boundary and track relevant atoms/electrons/cofactors before calculating.
Kinetic activation does not supply missing thermodynamic driving force.
Keep measured balances distinct from ideal fully coupled ratios and preserve unknown potentials/recovery.
Use route-specific demands to identify which biological comparison distinguishes apparent output equivalence.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: A coupled account resolves the isolated energy deficit
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Retain feasibility under assumptions; occurrence requires separate evidence (P11).

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Measured ratio differs from the ideal
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Preserve measurement and consider uncoupling/incomplete recovery.
Expose the changed demand instead of asserting full interchangeability.

boundary: The episode chooses the biological reaction boundary and missing coupled chemistry; a calculator only evaluates the selected account. P06 asks who supplies the output, P07 asks what rescue restores, and P11 asks whether a feasible account is used. Standard-potential feasibility is not measured cellular free energy or native flux; no credit weight is supplied.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Full relevant introduction, purification/assay methods, results, tables and discussion inspected; raw HTML and parsed paragraphs saved.
evidence.observation: Low-potential ferredoxin output needs the crotonyl-CoA reduction account; measured H2-assay ratios differ from the fully coupled extrapolation.
evidence.limit: Illustrative standard-potential arithmetic is not measured intracellular free energy or the microscopic mechanism.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Relevant expression/reconstitution/assay methods, results, stoichiometry figures and discussion inspected; supplements not independently reanalyzed.
evidence.observation: Reactant/product stoichiometry supports coupled transhydrogenation rather than NAD+ allostery alone.
evidence.limit: Reversibility does not establish physiological direction.

evidence.source_locator: Table 2 and Figs. 3–4; replacement route-bookkeeping trace.
evidence.observation: ThyA imposes folate recycling demand; ThyA plus FolA restored growth better than ThyA alone.
evidence.limit: Donor assumptions remain explicit; authors’ simulations were inspected, not rerun.

evidence.observation: BioZ and BioC/BioH carbon-entry accounts expose different reaction and reducing-step boundaries.
evidence.limit: Four versus two reducing steps is not four versus two NADPH; upstream costs stay outside the declared boundary.
